5. FEES, APPLICATION FORMS, AND SUBMITTAL CHECKLIST
5.1 Fees
Fees for all three routes are set by the current Clark County fee schedules adopted by the Board of County
Commissioners:
• Amended Final Map — Office of the County Surveyor technical review fee, per sheet; Recorder fees at

recordation.
• Vacation and Abandonment — Comprehensive Planning application fee, public hearing fee, notice/posting

fee, and Recorder fees for the Order of Vacation.
• Realignment plan check — Public Works resubmittal fee per plan check cycle for the affected sheets.

Applicants should confirm current fees at intake. Fees are payable at submittal; incomplete fee payment prevents
intake.

5.2 Application Forms
Current forms are available at the Clark County Development Services counter and on the Clark County website.
The forms most commonly required are:
• Amended Final Map Application (Public Works · Office of the County Surveyor).
• Vacation and Abandonment Application (Comprehensive Planning).
• Owner's Consent and Authorization (both routes).
• Utility Concurrence / Non-Objection Form (vacation route; not required for amended final map, where

signatures are on the mylar itself).
• Resubmittal Transmittal (realignment plan check cycles).

against the current form on file at Development Services before signing.

statement of justification.

I have audited the Comment `L-4` street tree revision against the Phase 3 landscape sheets (`DSR_Ph3_Landscape_L1-L4.pdf`), the common-area planting tabulation (`DSR_Ph3_Turf_Planting_Tabulation.xlsx`), the irrigation and water-budget worksheets (`DSR_Irrigation_Demand_Worksheet.xlsx`, `DSR_Ph3_Water_Budget.xlsx`), the Engineer's Estimate (`DSR_Ph3_Engineers_Estimate.xlsx`), and the Resubmittal Schedule and Task Tracker (`DSR_Ph3_Resubmittal_Tracker.xlsx`), and prepared the memorandum to Callaway Land Partners for your signature, dated **October 31, 2026 (`10/31/2026`)**.

### Delivered Files (under `output/`)
- `output/DSR_Ph3_Memo_to_Callaway_10312026.docx` — Word memorandum on Sundial Engineering & Survey letterhead prepared for signature by Max Braddock, Project Manager (and reviewed by Jonathan R. Kessler, PE, Principal-in-Charge), dated `10/31/2026`.
- `output/DSR_Ph3_Memo_to_Callaway_10312026.pdf` — 8-page PDF rendering of the memorandum.
- `output/DSR_Ph3_Memo_to_Callaway_10312026.md` — Markdown mirror of the complete memorandum and tables.

---

### Summary of Key Results

#### 1. Schedule Commitment Determination (`11/30/2026` Resubmittal & `12/18/2026` Recordation Target)
- **Can we commit to `11/30/2026` on a "clerical redline" basis? No.** While Ocotillo Landscape Studio (`Bea Cortland, PLA`) can complete the mechanical drafting of the **+150 street frontage trees** (`Comment L-4`) and the updated water budget by **`11/04/2026`** (well ahead of the `11/22/2026` internal QC freeze and `11/30/2026`), submitting the package on `11/30/2026` as a clerical redline relying on outside counsel's `10/20/2026` AB 356 single-family exemption email will result in plan-check rejection and will miss both Callaway's **`12/18/2026`** year-end recordation target and the true **`12/23/2026`** NRS 278.360 statutory map expiration deadline.
- **Why `11/30/2026` Fails the Review-Turnaround Math:**
  - **True Statutory Map Deadline Is `12/23/2026` (Not `03/14/2028`):** Contrary to Silver Butte Title's `10/26/2026` email (`Neil Petrosyan`), the first final map (`Desert Sage Ranch Phases 1 & 2`, `NFM-24-0118`) recorded on **`12/23/2024`** (`Book 175 of Plats, Page 60, Instrument No. 20241223-0004421`). Under **NRS 278.360**, each successive final map must be presented within **two (2) years** of the immediately preceding final map's recordation (**Wednesday, `12/23/2026`**), and per Comprehensive Planning's `12/30/2024` letter (`Odette Marchetti`), an Extension of Time **cannot be applied for or granted prior to expiration**.
  - **20-Business-Day County Turnaround:** Clark County Public Works (`Dale Yeoman, PE`) states a standard **20-business-day** second-round review turnaround (`CC-PW_1stReview_Comments_10092026.pdf`, p. 5). Measured from Monday, **`11/30/2026`**, 20 business days runs to **`12/28/2026–12/29/2026`**—past both **`12/18/2026`** (`14 business days` after `11/30`) and **`12/23/2026`** (`17 business days` after `11/30`), before counting mylar certificate routing (`Comment M-6`). To record by `12/18/2026`, the complete resubmittal package must be pulled forward to **`11/16/2026–11/20/2026`** (targeting **`11/18/2026`**) with expedited review and parallel mylar signature routing.

#### 2. Comment `L-4` Audit Against Current Landscape Sheets (`L-1`–`L-4`), Irrigation Demand & Bond Estimate
- **Street Frontage Tree Deficit (`Title 30 sec. 30.64.030(k)` — 1 medium-canopy tree per 20 LF):**
  - **Windmill Ln. (north frontage, landscape strip side, `2,560 LF`):** `128 required` vs. `34 shown` (`75.3 ft` avg. spacing) → **`+94 trees`**.
  - **Interior Collector — Desert Sage Pkwy. (both sides + median, `1,180 LF`):** `59 required` vs. `16 shown` (`73.8 ft` avg. spacing) → **`+43 trees`**.
  - **Rainbow Blvd. (entry frontage, east side, `420 LF`):** `21 required` vs. `8 shown` (`52.5 ft` avg. spacing) → **`+13 trees`**.
  - **Subtotal Street Frontage Trees (`24" box CHL, PAR, PBR`):** **`4,160 LF` → `208 required` vs. `58 shown` = `+150 street trees`**.
  - **Total Phase 3 Trees (All Sheets `L-1`–`L-4`):** Increases from **`74 trees` to `224 trees`** (`208` street frontage + `6` `PIE` entry monument on `L-4` + `10` `ULP` `36" box` park shade trees on `L-3`).
- **Updated Annual Irrigation Demand (`DSR_Irrigation_Demand_Worksheet.xlsx` & `DSR_Ph3_Water_Budget.xlsx`):**
  - **Tree Hydrozone (`HZ-3` at `2,000 gal/tree/yr`, `325,851 gal/ac-ft`):** Increases by `+150 trees × 2,000 gal = +300,000 gal/yr` (`+0.9207 ac-ft/yr`, or **`+0.92 ac-ft/yr`** rounded), taking total tree demand from `148,000 gal/yr` (**`0.45 ac-ft/yr`**, `0.4542` exact) to `448,000 gal/yr` (**`1.37 ac-ft/yr`**, `1.3749` exact).
  - **Scenario A — Standalone `L-4` Revision (retaining `18,400 sf` turf at `5.5 ft/yr = 2.32 ac-ft/yr` and `22,200 sf` drip planting at `1.0 ft/yr = 0.51 ac-ft/yr`):** Total annual demand increases from **`3.28 ac-ft/yr`** (`3.29 ac-ft/yr` unrounded; `1,071,093 gal/yr`) to **`4.20 ac-ft/yr`** (**`4.21 ac-ft/yr`** unrounded; `1,371,093 gal/yr`).
  - **Scenario B — Combined `L-2/L-3 + L-4` Revision (restoring the approved Phase 1–2 `4,200 sf` functional playground turf template at `5.5 ft/yr = 0.53 ac-ft/yr`):** Total annual demand drops to **`2.41 ac-ft/yr`** (`22,200 sf` drip) or **`2.59 ac-ft/yr`** (`30,200 sf` drip matching Phase 1–2's `12,800 sf` park drip footprint)—lower than the original `3.28 ac-ft/yr` submittal even with all 224 trees.
- **Companion Sheet Deficiencies Caught (`Comments L-1, L-4, L-5, L-6`):**
  - **`30%` 15-Year Shade Coverage Exhibit (`CP-PW-GM-2025-04`) & `Title 30 sec. 30.64.050` Alternative Standards:** Over the `77,300 sf` streetscape zone, `58` trees at a 20-ft 15-year canopy diameter provide only `18,221 sf` (`23.6%`), failing the 30% (`23,190 sf`) floor, whereas `208` trees provide `65,345 sf` (`84.5%`). Where sight-visibility zones (`Condition 6`), 60 driveways, 14 hydrants, 24 streetlights, or the `20-ft` north dry utility easement obstruct 20-ft spacing, Ocotillo must include a written `sec. 30.64.050` Alternative Standards justification.
  - **Schedule & Graphic Discrepancies (`Comment L-6`):** (i) The eight Shrub & Accent rows on `Sheet L-1` sum to **`1,192 plants`**, not the `1,202 plants` printed in the schedule footer; (ii) `882` streetscape shrubs/accents (`1,192 - 204 on L-3 - 106 on L-4`) lack a plant count table on `Sheet L-2`; (iii) `Sheet L-2` graphically plots only `28` street tree symbols (including `5 CHL` on the Local Street Loop, which is owner-planted at building permit); and (iv) `Sheet L-3` graphically plots `8 ULP` symbols vs. `10 ULP` in the schedule.
  - **Section Setbacks (`L-5`) & PLA Seal (`L-1`):** `Sheet L-2` Sections A, B, and C must dimension curb-to-planting setbacks and confirm `≥10-ft` turf setback (`sec. 30.64.030(j)`), and `Bea Cortland, PLA (NV LA #742)` must sign and wet-seal `Sheets L-1–L-4`.
- **Impact on Phase 3 Bonded Engineer's Estimate (`Advisory A-6` & Tracker `B-01`):**
  - Adding `150` `24" box` street trees (`Item 7.09` at `$485/EA` = **`+$72,750`**) plus `150` drip emitter assemblies (`Item 7.42` at `$12.50/EA` = **`+$1,875`**) increases the bonded total (rounded up to the next `$1,000` per Unit Cost Schedule `Sec. 12.02`) from **`$5,357,000`** to **`$5,430,000`** (`trees only`) or **`$5,432,000`** (`with emitters`)—or **`$5,416,000–$5,417,000`** if `14,200 sf` of turf (`$2.15/sf`) is converted to `3" DG` (`$1.15/sf`, net `-$14,200`).

#### 3. What Has to Happen First (Seven Critical-Path Prerequisites)
1. **Park Turf & `Condition 14` Public Hearing Avoidance (`Comments L-2, L-3, Advisory A-3`, Decision Needed by `11/03/2026`):** SNWA Bulletin `WRC-2024-07` (`Sec. 2`) explicitly states that the AB 356 single-family residential carve-out is **lot-based, not project-based**, and **excludes HOA common-area parks** regardless of R-2 zoning, and `CP-PW-GM-2025-04` (`Sec. 4`) bars waiving `sec. 30.64.030(j)` turf rules. Because the July 2026 VE pass stripped playground equipment while expanding turf from `4,200 sf` to `18,400 sf` of passive lawn, `Sheet L-3` fails `WRC-2024-07 Sec. 3.1/3.2` and triggers a mandatory **Condition 14** Enterprise TAB and Planning Commission public hearing (for which the `10/28/2026` filing cutoff for the `11/18/2026` TAB meeting has already passed, and HOA homeowners are already organizing to protest at the `11/18/2026` TAB meeting). Callaway must authorize restoring the approved Phase 1–2 functional park layout (`4,200 sf` functional playground turf inside a bordered play area with installed slides, swings, and climbing structures, converting `14,200 sf` of passive turf to desert planting/DG) and updating the `Sheet L-1` note (`Comment L-3`) to keep review at staff level.
2. **Statutory Map Clock Confirmation (`Comment M-1`, by `11/06/2026`) & Accelerated Resubmittal (`11/18/2026`):** Transmit the `12/23/2024` Phase 1–2 recording reference (`Book 175, Page 60, Inst. #20241223-0004421`) to Odette Marchetti to obtain Comprehensive Planning's formal confirmation of the **`12/23/2026`** NRS 278.360 deadline, and accelerate resubmittal to **`11/18/2026`**.
3. **In-House Realignment Clear of the Recorded `20.00-ft` North-Boundary Dry Utility Easement (`Comments U-1, U-5, M-2, Advisory A-1`, by `11/13/2026`):** Rebuild the CAD base to the recorded Phase 1–2 Final Map (`NFM-24-0118`) and shift Storm Drain Trunk `Line A` (`Sheet C-8`, currently at a `10.0-ft` offset inside the recorded `20.00-ft` Dry Utility Easement in `Book 175, Page 60`) and north-perimeter trees south of the `20-ft` easement corridor under Section 4 of `CC_Map_Amendment_and_Vacation_Procedures.pdf`, avoiding a 5-week Amended Final Map.
4. **CCWRD Sanitary Sewer Capacity Renewal (`Comment U-2, Advisory A-4`, file `11/02/2026` / issue by `11/10/2026`):** Renew `CCWRD-SCC-2025-1187` (which expired after 1 year on **`09/30/2026`**) with Vince Alarid at CCWRD (`LVVWD-WS-2026-3341` remains valid through `07/22/2028`).
5. **CCFD Permanent Second Fire Access & Cul-de-Sac Radii (`Comments F-1–F-4`, by `11/10/2026`):** Coordinate with Capt. Emmett Roark (CCFD) to add a permanent second fire access connection on `C-2/FA-1` per `FPB-2023-0417` (also required to release the remaining `$2,100,000` onsite portion of Phase 2 Bond `SU-2222-2023-Ph2`), widen the Cholla Ct. and Yucca Ct. cul-de-sac inside turning radii from `15 ft` to `45 ft` minimum (`F-2`), and add hydrant flow (`F-3`) and Fire Lane signage (`F-4`).
6. **Active Phase 3 NDEP `NVR100000` Stormwater NOI (`Comment G-8, Advisory A-5`, by `11/10/2026`):** File a new `40.0-acre` Phase 3 NOI with NDEP (replacing `NDEP-NVR-2022-1188`, which was terminated on `03/24/2025` under `NDEP-NOT-2025-0442`) for the new stand-alone ESC sheet.
7. **Remaining Civil, Wet Utility & Mapping/Signatory Items (`G-1–G-7, U-3–U-4, M-3–M-7`, by `11/13/2026`):** Confirm Callaway's authorized signatory (`M-5`), reconcile the `FM-26-100290` Basis of Bearings (`N 00°02'18" W` vs. `N 89°57'42" E` on `NFM-24-0118`, `M-3`), plot Schedule B exceptions from `SBT-2026-04188` (`M-4`), obtain RFCD confirmation of the `6.4 ac-ft` detention allocation (`G-3`), fix `C-8` pipe cover at `Sta. 4+80` (`2.6 ft` vs. `3.0 ft` min, `G-5`), add sag inlet capacity calcs (`G-6`), and detail Phase 2 stub tie-in/removal (`G-7`).
